answer: Weight leaks: linked funding trails are folded into one willow that mints only one ripple per epoch, and a head counts only while its re-bought capacity stays off nadir. Behind that willow, the kth live head must re-buy k^2 ripple before speaking; touching nadir forfeits the spend and resets that head. First head: 1 serial epoch. Ten clones: 1+4+...+100=385 serial ripple-epochs; fresh wallets still feed the same willow.
